characters.name: Rich Per the Pedlar
characters.description: A wealthy travelling trader who becomes obsessed with preventing a prophecy and grows increasingly ruthless, only to be trapped by his own schemes.
characters.look: A tall, bony man of about sixty with a long, horsey face, a jutting chin, a sharp hooked nose, small, darting, greedy grey eyes, a thin mouth, bushy salt-and-pepper side-whiskers and slicked-back black hair streaked with grey, with a sharp widow's peak. characters.look: A tall, willowy woman in her mid-thirties with a long neck, a narrow face with a delicate chin, a small straight nose, soft brown eyes under pale brows, pink cheeks and a calm, patient expression. She wears a midnight-blue wool dress with a band of red-and-white woven trim at the hem and cuffs, and a round silver brooch at her collar.

She wears a long turquoise wool gown with wide bell sleeves, a silver-embroidered belt and soft grey slippers.

characters.name: The Ferryman
